scenes.en: Kavin's mother noticed this one evening.
scenes.say: Eight year old Kavin read with his book almost touching his nose. His mother noticed it one evening.

scenes.en: Squinting at the TV, sitting too close, tilting his head, headaches.
scenes.ta: கண்ணை சுருக்குவது, டிவி அருகில் உட்காருவது, தலைவலி
scenes.say: There were other clues. He squinted at the TV, sat very close to it, tilted his head, and got headaches after school.

scenes.en: Short sight, long sight, astigmatism, or one weaker eye.
scenes.ta: கிட்டப்பார்வை, தூரப்பார்வை, அல்லது ஒரு கண் பலவீனம்
scenes.say: Holding books very close can mean short sight, long sight, astigmatism, or one eye seeing less clearly than the other.

scenes.en: Kids rarely complain. They think everyone sees the way they do.
scenes.say: Did you know? Children rarely complain about blurry vision. They think everyone sees the world the way they do.

scenes.en: A lazy eye responds best when treated in early childhood.
scenes.say: Some problems, like a lazy eye, respond best when they are treated in early childhood. So don't wait.

scenes.en: He needed glasses. Now he reads at a normal distance.
scenes.ta: கண்ணாடி அணிந்த பிறகு சரியான தூரத்தில் படிக்கிறான்
scenes.say: Kavin's eye test showed he needed glasses. Now he reads at a normal distance, and he enjoys it.

scenes.en: Book a yearly eye test for your child.
scenes.say: Watch for these signs, and book a yearly eye test for your child.
